resources.string: When the screen is off, Telos can park radios and sensors, then wake them on a schedule for weather or account sync. Off until you turn it on. Needs Shizuku or root. Incoming phone and messaging calls keep the microphone. Maps-style apps keep GPS while they are in the foreground.
Connect Shizuku or root in the Shizuku tab before enabling this.
Apply the switches below about 20 seconds after the display turns off. Restores the previous state when you wake the phone.
Skips this if a navigation app you keep is in the foreground.
Wi-Fi is left alone. Skipped during an active call hold app.
Re-enabled automatically for an incoming or active phone or messaging call.
Uses Android sensor privacy. Restored on wake.
Android contacts/mail sync. The hourly wake below can run a forced sync.
Turn location and data on for about 45 seconds each hour, then park them again if the screen is still off.
Turn data on, request Android sync, then park again.
Android dropped the live wallpaper after the Telos update. The file is still on the device. Tap to set it again.
